text.p: Veteran England defender Stuart Pearce joined Newcastle on Friday, a day after being given a free transfer by Nottingham Forest.
Pearce, 35, underwent a medical and signed a three-year contract with last season's premier league runners-up.
He left Forest, who were relegated from the top flight last season, saying he wanted to play in the premier league to enhance his chances of representing England in the World Cup.
There was speculation that Pearce would move south but instead he joined Kenny Dalglish's side who recently sold left-back Robbie Elliott to Bolton.
